selectedActions: Inspect only exact36 verified archives as data. Host Python standard libraries may perform bounded ar/control/data tar inspection before native extraction; no host package extraction or installation. Record tool/library versions and actual member/link graphs.

Before extraction reject traversal/absolute members, duplicate inconsistent paths, special nodes, escaping links and archive ambiguity; validate complete cross-package path graph. Preserve legitimate relative compiler/sysroot links only with explicit inside-prefix resolution. No executable script invocation.

Observe/hash pinned native dpkg-deb/tar/decompressor tools and use them only for static metadata or validated archive data extraction into private noexec /tmp/compiler-payload/tree. No apt/dpkg install/configure, alternatives, wrappers, compiler execution or BEAM invocation.

Record per-file/link/type/size/SHA256 manifest and actual expanded sizes, data-only package control/copyright notices. Include immutable original ERTS17.1 NIF headers by exact V3 hashes as data if needed; no NIF load.

Export only four fixed named artifacts with their separate hard bounds; compiler-only tar is a local external verification cache, not a committed product. Same readonly mount/nonroot/network-none/noexec/cleanup policy; no writable host mounts.

Fail and preserve evidence on any bound or unsupported member/tool condition. No silent retry, budget expansion, image/rootfs publication or runtime-base replacement. /usr/bin/cc alternatives missing stays explicit pending.
